text:
maya-sales: Quick sync — Alder Retail POC kicks off Mon. They want streaming + function-calls + structured receipts. Need a concise SDK example we can hand to their engs, and a pricing estimate for ~50k tokens/day. Any obvious blockers (security, infra)?

ashley-alder: Thanks Maya — quick context: endpoints we plan to use: product_recognize, price_lookup, receipt_struct. Target realtime latency ~200ms for the critical flow. Will start with hosted POC but may move to dedicated.

jin-presales: 200ms is achievable but depends on model and batch settings. For POC on hosted API we should set batching=0 (low-latency mode) and use a smaller seq-length model variant. I'll post a tiny JS snippet for streaming + function calls.

lucas-se: Example JS (streaming + function tool):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = client.chat.stream({
  model: 'redwood-lite-1',
  messages: [{role:'user', content: 'Parse this receipt PNG -> structured JSON'}],
  functions: [{name:'extract_receipt', description:'extract fields'}],
  structured_output: {type: 'json_schema', schema: {total:'number', items:'array'}}
});
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.delta);
}
```

maya-sales: Thanks — that helps. Pricing: 50k tokens/day ~ 1.5M tokens/mo. Jin — rough hosted cost vs dedicated? Need a number to show Alder execs.

jin-presales: Rough math: hosted list-price (est) $0.0003/token => ~$450/mo. For production at their latency, Dedicated reserved pool is recommended: typical reserved commit starts ~$2.5k/mo (depends on GPU profile). I'll pull exact quote from pricing team and confirm discounts.

priaya-sec: Security checklist: Alder wants SOC2 + IP allowlist + SSO + audit logs. For POC we can enable IP allowlist + API keys scoped to project and short TTL. For PROD we'd propose Private (VPC) or Dedicated with customer KMS for encryption at rest and full audit logs. I'll attach the one-pager in the meeting.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created infra request RDW-1234 to reserve a small low-latency hosted test slot for the POC. ETA 48h.

ashley-alder: Also need a sample of structured response schema so our data team can map fields into warehouse. Legal also asked for a sample audit log snippet.

jin-presales: Minimal schema snippet (will DM JSON file):
```json
{
  "receipt_id": "string",
  "total": "number",
  "currency": "string",
  "items": [{"sku":"string","qty":"integer","price":"number"}]
}
```
I'll also include an example audit log line (api key, route, ts, bytes_in/out).

lucas-se: FYI one gotcha: function-call streaming may include tool outputs that exceed a single event. Advise Alder to support incremental apply of tool chunks and to set reasonable max_chunk_size. Also KV cache for repeated receipts can cut token regen costs a lot.

maya-sales: Can we schedule a technical deep-dive Thurs 10am PT with Alder eng + security? I'll bring Jin + Priya + Lucas.

ashley-alder: Yes Thurs 10am PT works. Please include the short POC checklist and a pre-call checklist for the Alder SRE folks.

maya-sales: Meeting invite sent — included agenda + checklist. :calendar:

jin-presales: Post-meeting action items I'll own: 1) finalize SDK example repo link, 2) exact hosted vs dedicated pricing numbers, 3) sample audit log + security one-pager.

priaya-sec: I'll prep IP allowlist steps and SSO/SAML notes.

maya-sales: Great — closing loop here. If anyone sees a blocker before Thu ping in thread. :thumbsup:
